thread:
rachael: quick sync: we still have ambiguity when a service needs to act across project boundaries. want a short decision so i can finish the rfc.
sam: summary: prefer project-scoped keys by default. allow org-operator flows only with short-lived attestation.
jon: +1. two options for attestation: propagate original claim or have trusted proxy mint a new claim that includes original caller. propagation preferred where possible.
kevin: practical: many proxies can't propagate headers today. require minting agents to have a cert and include orig_request_id + caller_project in minted claim. TTL <= 15m for destructive ops.
rachael: gateway pseudo: if X-Operator-Claim -> verify sig && check ttl && policy, else if key.org && route.allows_org_key -> allow read-only, reject writes.
sam: migration: 1) accept claims and log telemetry (30d), 2) require claims for write/delete (90d), 3) deprecate long-lived org write keys (180d).
jon: CI: allowlist infra CI service accounts for cross-project creates but must rotate keys and include ticket ref in claim.reason. exemptions timeboxed.
kevin: security: destructive routes DENY unless claim.ttl <= 900 and claim.reason in allowlist. require MFA in console flows.
attest-bot: signer-service: deployed staging at 1758004800.
rachael: i'll write the short RFC with the gateway enforcement and migration timeline. please drop edge cases in the thread.
sam: add replay protection (nonce) and per-region signer keys to the RFC.
jon: we'll inventory org keys and list top consumers.
kevin: i'll prototype proxy minting code and a sample claim format.
rachael: thanks everyone, feels like convergence. will post RFC in #eng-security-rfcs by EOD. :thumbsup:
